mechanism.statement: FP4 scales, signed code statistics, and effective weight profiles can be used as a low-cost information side-channel to guide legal pre-W1 function selection or post-Q2 W2 K-panel dispatch. The target is signed joint gated/downstream action error plus real computation cost, not hidden-channel energy alone. Native Wan predictive and deployable gains remain open.
mechanism.math_or_trace:
With legal fixed-Q2 W2-only omissions and a frozen linear readout P, d_j=P diag(g) B_j h_j. For S omitted, E[||sum_{j∈S}d_j||²|Z]=sum_{i,j∈S}(mu_i(Z)^T mu_j(Z)+tr Cov(d_i,d_j|Z)); real arithmetic conditional-moment identity. Original quant+new sparse errors have cross term 2

. Pre-W1 Q1 action requires new full legal W1/GELU/Q2 computation; cannot reuse fixed-Q2 additive formula. NetVOI=R(F0)-R(F1)-Cextract-Croute over restricted feasible policies and same action set.

availability.earliest_decision_time: Q1 scales/codes strictly after actual Q1 producer and before W1; Q2 metadata strictly after W1+GELU+Q2 and before W2
availability.observer_computation: Q1/Q2 fake-QDQ HiF4 source retains no accessible persistent scale tensor; capture/materialization, code statistics, routing, synchronization, packed layout and kernel cost are accounted separately; offline W1/W2 profiles can be resident
availability.online_or_posthoc: Q1/Q2 observable only with paid native producer; target contribution and suffix finite labels are OFFLINE_ORACLE only

real_cost.W1: Q1 early policy may save W1 only if a physically legal alternative FFN actually executes less W1; Q2 decisions have fully paid W1/GELU/Q2
real_cost.W2: Whole W2 physical K-panel elision after Q2 is valid; sparse token mask that leaves every tile active does not save kernel work
real_cost.QDQ: HiF4 64-scale nested coupling; MXFP4 32/E8M0 and NVFP4 16/E4M3+global use different producer/packing contracts
real_cost.routing_memory: Producer metadata export, signed sketch, lowrank score, resident weights and tile dispatch charged; comparison against native packed FP4 dense when appropriate
real_cost.downstream: Gate, residual, full four-step video motion and source-level metrics remain unmeasured for this method

evidence.scope: conditional moments, quant+sparse cross-term and decision value objective; native predictive claims OPEN
Q1 and Q2 dataflow, earlier scale-rank-collapse analysis and QDQ scale producer unavailable as persistent tensor
rearrangement certificates, code-domain algebra and GEMV-vs-GEMM prior art
historical scalar summaries do not contain raw Q1/Q2 codes/scales

countermechanism.statement: Quantizer scale changes mostly reflect magnitude/outlier artifacts and cannot change optimal physical action after cheap RMS/step/gate and static weight-profile conditioning; signed code summaries may improve local ranking but lose to native packed dense once acquisition and tile occupancy are paid.
countermechanism.prediction: On disjoint source clusters, Q1-S and Q1-C fail to improve matched action regret/NetVOI; post-Q2 tile occupancy remains effectively dense, while cheap baseline or M-A0 same-budget fixed policy performs as well.

discriminator: Static profile dominance/rank and producer check, then registered heldout comparison F0/F1/Q1-S/Q1-C and separately Q2-S/Q2-C; compare legal same-state action labels, physically coalesced tile occupancy, real native timing and complete full-video behavior if method is advanced.
